_comment: Informative-reference crosswalks from the NIST Cybersecurity Framework (CSF) 2.0 to identifiers in other frameworks, as published through NIST's National Online Informative References (OLIR) Program and retrieved from the NIST CSF 2.0 reference data service (https://csrc.nist.gov/extensions/nudp/services/json/csf/elements and https://csrc.nist.gov/extensions/nudp/services/json/csf/olirs). IDENTIFIERS ONLY: no control or requirement text and no control titles of any referenced framework are included, and each framework remains the property of its publisher. A mapping records that a CSF element and a reference are related; it is not an equivalence and not a determination of conformance. Each relationship is kept at the level its mapping records it: "mappings" for one Subcategory, "categoryMappings" for a whole Category, "functionMappings" for a whole Function. "developer" is the mapping's developer of record in NIST's catalog ("catalogUrl"); "thirdParty": true marks a mapping developed by neither NIST nor the publisher of the referenced framework, reproduced as published. "sourceUrl" is the mapping's own document when NIST hosts it, otherwise null: this file carries no links to third-party pages. Regenerate with scripts/build-crosswalks.js (npm run build-crosswalks).
source: NIST National Online Informative References (OLIR) Program, via the NIST CSF 2.0 reference data service
